verdict.comment: JPR One (second choice) and Unexpected Party are respected but MY MATE MOZZIE is taken to gain a deserved big handicap success.

comments.americanmike: Smart chaser who has run with credit in competitive events at Fairyhouse last twice
comments.conyershill: Won Down Royal novice chase latest but his jumping doesn't look sharp enough for this test
comments.dancingonmyown: Has some good C&D form but suspicion this 11yo might be vulnerable to younger legs
comments.fringilldike: Added two more chase wins in first half of season; absent since October; others preferred
comments.gaelicarc: In and out since Killarney win last July; others are much more obvious
comments.generalmedrano: Has progressed again this term, shaping well when second at Doncaster latest
comments.jprone: Haldon Gold Cup defeat of Djelo is strong form; fair runs in Graded races since; classy
comments.jaskodesdames: Excuses last time; solid record otherwise over fences; handicap chase debut; strong yard
comments.jazzymatty: Won Fred Winter here in 2023; dual chase winner but lacks big-field experience over fences
comments.martator: Made it five wins in row when landing two good pots at Ascot in November; struggled lately
comments.midnightitis: Won on reappearance; good third next time and had a possible excuse latest
comments.mymatemozzie: Good record in big handicaps under all codes; shaped well in chase at Leopardstown latest
comments.nellsson: Better than ever this term but mark has gone up and General Medrano ahead of him latest
comments.primoz: Has a 2-5 chase record but has never experienced a race of this nature
comments.soscottish: Not seen over fences since a fall here in December 2023; some good hurdle efforts since
comments.thekingofprs: Beaten when falling in this last year but has resumed his progress this season
comments.thirdtimelucki: Fourth in this in 2023 but has struggled in three runs for new yard after long absence
comments.traprainlaw: Better signs latest and feasibly treated on last season's front-running 2m form
comments.unexpectedparty: Last year's winner and good chance he's been primed for this again; shortlisted
comments.westernzephyr: Started the season well but distant third at Ascot in December; freshened up since

races.raceComment: primoz is marginally preferred with a score of 62.0%. Won 3 of last 5 starts. Ground (Good To Soft) looks ideal with 4 wins from 9 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Excellent course form of 4/10 at cheltenham. Key attributes include optimal distance and strong course form, though step up in class need consideration.

verdict.comment: Willie Mullins again brings strength in numpers but one who could repel his battalion is KALYPSO'CHANCE who has looked exciting.

comments.aquaforce: Bolted up at Gowran last month; since purchased by JP McManus and moved to Willie Mullins
comments.bambinofever: Powered away from a solid yardstick in a Grade 2 for mares; females have won this
comments.caballerocliff: Fourth in a Listed event but has masses to find and maidens don't win this race
comments.copacabana: One of his strong stable's main contenders after impressing at Navan a month ago
comments.dalstonlad: Aintree form has taken some knocks and Harry Skelton prefers Fortune De Mer
comments.elcairos: Won easily at Newbury but in a modest race and has a lot to find on all the figures
comments.fortunedemer: Course Listed winner; forget last time as he pulled too hard off tepid fractions
comments.gameofinches: Well regarded by his top yard and couldn't have been more impressive at Punchestown
comments.hecantdance: Nice prospect but might just lack the finishing kick to win one of these
comments.headsup: Held by Kalypso'chance on their Navan clash and there are others for him to worry about
comments.highlandhaven: Twice beaten since her debut win at Ffos Las (good to soft) and looks outclassed
comments.istartedajoke: Seems well regarded but very opposable on what he's achieved to date
comments.idahosun: Has won twice in the mud, really impressing at Windsor last time; he's promising
comments.kalypsochance: British point winner; unextended in his two Irish bumpers and clearly very talented
comments.lancelotallen: Off since a Bangor win in December; only one 4yo (Cue Card) has won this race since 1995
comments.nodramathisend: Easy winner of a British point and Warwick bumper; trainer has threatened to win this
comments.shuttlediplomacy: Listed winner last season before held in a Grade 1; has a long absence to overcome
comments.sortudo: Has a solid profile but it's likely that he lacks the same star potential of some in here

races.raceComment: bambinofever is marginally preferred with a score of 36.6%. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Excellent course form of 3/3 at cheltenham.
